description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git diff' under various options such as -B and -M. It sets up a test environment with files, manipulates them, runs diff commands, and compares the output to expected results. The script demonstrates how diff handles reordering, renaming, copying, and other modifications of files in a git repository context.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with certain setup or assertions.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares the actual diff output with the expected output.
